findings.note: first review pass: parallel logins could bypass the backoff; throttle check and count now atomic (tryBeginAttempt)
first review pass: XSRF-TOKEN not rotated on login; now rotated on login and logout
a login that threw while creating its session reset the backoff; reset now happens after the session is saved
parallel requests with one expired session cookie could get 500; expired session removed with bulk deleteByTokenHash
